list.name: run_id
list.label: Run ID
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM backtest_equity_curve ORDER BY run_id DESC

panels.title: Equity curves (all selected)
panels.description: Main (PDT-enforced) vs unconstrained (PDT bypassed) vs benchmarks. Overlaid so alpha and drag are visually obvious. Y-axis is dollar equity; start = initial_cash for every curve.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time,
       run_id || '/' || curve_type AS metric,
       equity AS value
  FROM backtest_equity_curve
 WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'
   AND curve_type IN (${curve:sqlstring})
   AND $__timeFilter(ts)
 ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Cumulative return vs benchmark (bps)
panels.description: Cumulative return in basis points, relative to initial_cash. Diverging curves = alpha; converging = drag.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time,
       run_id || '/' || curve_type AS metric,
       cum_return_bps AS value
  FROM backtest_equity_curve
 WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'
   AND curve_type IN (${curve:sqlstring})
   AND $__timeFilter(ts)
 ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Drawdown from running peak (%)
panels.description: Portfolio drawdown from prior peak. Deeper = worse. Compare main vs SPY to see if the strategy trades off vol for downside capture.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT ts, run_id, curve_type, equity,
         MAX(equity) OVER (PARTITION BY run_id, curve_type ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS peak
    FROM backtest_equity_curve
   WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'
     AND curve_type IN (${curve:sqlstring})
)
SELECT ts AS time,
       run_id || '/' || curve_type AS metric,
       100.0 * (equity / peak - 1.0) AS value
  FROM ranked
 WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
 ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Metric summary (all selected runs and curves)
panels.description: Long/tall metrics table from backtest_metrics. Use column filters to focus on Sharpe, alpha, drawdown, etc.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT run_id, curve_type, metric_name, ROUND(metric_value, 4) AS value, metric_unit
  FROM backtest_metrics
 WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'
   AND curve_type IN (${curve:sqlstring})
 ORDER BY run_id, curve_type, metric_name
SELECT metric_value FROM backtest_metrics WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND curve_type = 'main' AND metric_name = 'sharpe_annualized' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT metric_value FROM backtest_metrics WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND curve_type = 'main' AND metric_name = 'capm_alpha_annualized_bps' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT metric_value FROM backtest_metrics WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND curve_type = 'main' AND metric_name = 'max_drawdown_pct' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT metric_value FROM backtest_metrics WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND curve_type = 'main' AND metric_name = 'cagr_pct' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Rolling 63d Sharpe (main vs SPY)
panels.description: 63-day rolling annualized Sharpe. Rising = strategy is compounding through this window; falling = alpha decay.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ret AS (
  SELECT ts, run_id, curve_type,
         daily_return_bps / 10000.0 AS r
    FROM backtest_equity_curve
   WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'
     AND curve_type IN (${curve:sqlstring})
)
SELECT ts AS time,
       run_id || '/' || curve_type AS metric,
       (AVG(r) OVER (PARTITION BY run_id, curve_type ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 62 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
        / NULLIF(STDDEV(r) OVER (PARTITION BY run_id, curve_type ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 62 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0)
        * SQRT(252)) AS value
  FROM ret
 WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
 ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Cost components per day (bps, aggregated across all fills)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time,
       'entry' AS metric,
       AVG(entry_cost_bps) AS value
  FROM backtest_gateway_actions
 WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND curve_type = 'main' AND executed = TRUE
   AND $__timeFilter(ts)
 GROUP BY ts
UNION ALL
SELECT ts, 'queue', AVG(queue_delay_bps) FROM backtest_gateway_actions WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND curve_type = 'main' AND executed = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts
UNION ALL
SELECT ts, 'action_memory', AVG(action_memory_bps) FROM backtest_gateway_actions WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND curve_type = 'main' AND executed = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts
UNION ALL
SELECT ts, 'operational', AVG(operational_bps) FROM backtest_gateway_actions WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND curve_type = 'main' AND executed = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Gross edge vs net edge (bps, main)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, 'gross_edge_bps' AS metric, AVG(gross_edge_bps) AS value FROM backtest_gateway_actions WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND curve_type = 'main' AND executed = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, 'net_edge_bps' AS metric, AVG(net_edge_bps) AS value FROM backtest_gateway_actions WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND curve_type = 'main' AND executed = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Position count over time (main vs unconstrained)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time,
       run_id || '/' || curve_type AS metric,
       position_count AS value
  FROM backtest_equity_curve
 WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'
   AND curve_type IN ('main', 'unconstrained')
   AND $__timeFilter(ts)
 ORDER BY ts

panels.title: PDT day-trade count (main)
panels.description: Rolling 5-trading-day count with cap at 3. When this rides the cap, alpha is being throttled.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, 'pdt_count' AS metric, pdt_day_trade_count AS value FROM backtest_equity_curve WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND curve_type = 'main' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Top 20 winners/losers by symbol (main, cumulative fill P&L)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT symbol,
       SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'buy' THEN -qty * fill_price ELSE qty * fill_price END) AS realized_pnl_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'buy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_buys,
       SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'sell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_sells,
       AVG(slippage_bps) AS avg_slippage_bps
  FROM backtest_executions
 WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'
   AND curve_type = 'main'
 GROUP BY symbol
 ORDER BY ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'buy' THEN -qty * fill_price ELSE qty * fill_price END)) DESC
 LIMIT 20
SELECT ts AS time, run_id AS metric, stress_ema AS value FROM backtest_market_regime WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND stress_ema IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Sharpe by regime quintile (main)
panels.description: Q1_calm through Q5_stress. Rising bars from Q1→Q5 = strategy shines under stress; falling = fair-weather system.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT metric_name AS bucket, metric_value AS sharpe
  FROM backtest_metrics
 WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'
   AND curve_type = 'main'
   AND metric_name LIKE 'sharpe_by_regime_%'
 ORDER BY metric_name

SELECT run_id, started_at, ended_at, start_date, end_date, fill_model, walkforward_days, universe_size, n_cycles, notes, cli_args FROM backtest_metadata WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY started_at DESC
SELECT ts AS time, run_id AS metric, n_samples AS value FROM backtest_bayes_snapshots WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
